On April 30, 2026, the Poiesis project stepped outside its usual pilot-workshop settings and into one of Vienna's major cultural institutions. IRARU, the Austrian coordinator of Poiesis, was invited together with LEFÖ — a Viennese association supporting migrant women — to take part in the exhibition of the Vienna Latina consortium at the Wien Museum, alongside several other Latin American organisations.
